title: Code and data for: An Error Budget for the SRK and PR Equations of State
description: Reproducible benchmark of the Soave–Redlich–Kwong and Peng–Robinson cubic equations of state against CoolProp reference equations for 37 pure fluids (1480 saturation states): seven alpha-functions, a volume-translation ladder, and fluid-level cluster-bootstrap statistics. Includes all scripts, tabulated results and a manuscript-number verification suite.
